A Supermemory‑t a mostani appodban elsősorban három nagy irányban tudod maximálisan kihasználni: per‑user hosszú távú memória, domain‑tudásbázis (RAG), és „infinite chat” típusú AI‑asszisztens, ami a tranzakciós és analitikai adataidra épít.[1][2]
Mindezt kombinálhatod a meglévő Erste‑, Stripe‑, Coinbase‑ és KDB‑rétegeddel, így gyakorlatilag egy AI‑vezérelt, „önmagát tanító” pénzügyi platformot tudsz építeni.[2][1]

 1. Per‑user hosszú távú memória

A Supermemory memóriái nem sima fájlok, hanem szemantikus „knowledge unit”ok egy gráfban, ahol dokumentumokból automatikusan kapcsolt memóriadarabok jönnek létre.[1]
Ezért minden fontos user‑eseményt (regisztráció, Erste‑kapcsolás, fizetés, sikertelen próbálkozás, KDB‑alapú insight) érdemes „storyként” felküldeni a Memories API‑ba, containerTag‑ekkel, pl. ["user:{id}", "payments"].[2][1]

Konkrétan a PaymentProcessor.processpayment metódusokban (Erste, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Coinbase) a sikeres vagy failed commit után hívj egy Supermemory memories.add‑et, tartalommal: „User {username} {amount} {currency} összeget fizetett {recipientname}/{description}, method: {paymentmethod}, status: {status}, idő: {created_at}”.[2]
Metaadatban tedd bele legalább: user_id, payment_id, payment_method, status, created_at, és containerTags=["user:{id}", "payments", payment_method], így user‑szinten és metódus szerint is tudsz keresni és szűrni.[1][2]

 2. Tranzakciós tudásbázis & RAG

A Supermemory dokumentum‑szintű ingestet is ad: PDF, web, plain text, markdown, stb., amiből automatikusan memóriagráfot épít.[1]
Ide be tudod húzni az Erste API dokumentációt, saját ÁSZF‑et, díjstruktúrákat, FAQ‑t, compliance anyagokat, hogy egy későbbi AI‑asszisztens regulation‑kompatibilis válaszokat adjon.[2][1]

Használhatod a „Add Simple Text / Add Markdown / Upload File / Add URLs” mintákat, pl. a supermemory.memories.uploadFile PDF szerződésre vagy memories.add(content=url) banki cikkekre.[1]
A kereső endpointra (search memories) ráakaszthatsz egy saját /api/assistant/faq route‑ot Flaskben, ami először Supermemory‑t kérdezi FAQ‑ért, majd a találatokat adja oda a LLM‑nek válasz generálásra.[2][1]

 3. Infinite Chat / Memory Router integráció

A Memory Routerrel úgy tudsz „végtelen kontextusú” chatet csinálni, hogy egyszerűen a meglévő OpenAI‑kompatibilis klienst a Supermemory proxy URL‑re állítod (https://api.supermemory.ai/v3/https://api.openai.com/v1).[1]
Fejlécbe beteszed az OpenAI kulcsot, plusz x-supermemory-api-key és x-sm-user-id: current_user.id, így a teljes beszélgetés automatikusan chunkolódik, tárolódik és visszakerül, ha túlnő az LLM kontextusán.[2][1]

Érdemes felvenni egy új endpointot, pl. @app.route("/api/chat", methods=["POST"]), ami a frontendes chat UI‑ból kap üzenetet, és a Memory Routeren keresztül hívja a modellt.[2]
A Supermemory ilyenkor magától kezeli, hogy mikor mennyi előzményt adjon vissza, optimalizálja a token‑költséget, és hosszú távon „emlékszik”, hogy a user milyen célokat, preferenciákat mondott korábban.[1]

 4. Dokumentum‑ és fájl‑feltöltés a felhasználóknak

Adhatsz a frontendre egy receipt/invoice upload funkciót, ami a Supermemory File Upload API‑t hívja (PDF, kép OCR‑ral, CSV).[1]
Pl. a user feltölti a számláit, te pedig uploadFile(file, containerTags=["user:{id}", "receipts"]) hívással beküldöd, és a Supermemory automatikusan kinyeri a szöveget.[2][1]

Később egy AI‑asszisztens („Kiadás elemző”) a Supermemory‑ból lehúzott memóriák alapján megmondja: milyen merchant típusok, tipikus összegek, visszatérő költségek vannak, teljesen szemantikusan.[1]
Ez jól kombinálható a KDB‑ben futó aggregációkkal: a KDB adja a pontos számokat, Supermemory pedig a narratív, nyelvi magyarázatot és a hosszú távú kontextust.[2][1]

 5. KDB analitika + Supermemory „insight memóriák”

Most is van KdbClient és KdbSyncService, ami fizetéseket és tranzakciókat tol KDB‑be, plusz analitikai endpointok: revenue, success‑rate, hourly‑volume, failure‑analysis.[2]
Erre rá tudsz építeni egy cron‑t vagy background jobot, ami naponta/havonta összefoglaló mondatokat generál (akár egy kis LLM‑mel), és ezeket insight‑ként beküldi a Supermemory‑ba.[1][2]

Például: „2025‑11‑hó: User {id} kártyás fizetéseinek 72%‑a sikeres, a leggyakoribb method: Apple Pay, átlagos ticket: 8 200 HUF.”[2]
ContainerTag: ["user:{id}", "analytics", "monthly_insight"], típus metaadattal {"source": "kdb", "period": "2025-11", "metric": "payments"}, így az asszisztens pillanatok alatt tud trendeket, összehasonlítást és magyarázatot adni.[1][2]

 6. Konkrét integrációs pontok a meglévő kódban

 Fizetés létrehozás/állapotváltás  
  A PaymentProcessor.processerstepayment / processapplepay / processgooglepay / processcoinbase végén, a db.session.commit után hívd meg a Supermemory memories.add‑et a fizetés adataival.[2]
  Ugyanezt tedd meg a checkpaymentstatus végén is, ha a status változott (initiated → completed/failed), hogy a memóriák tükrözzék az életciklust.[2]

 Erste auth + account import  
  Az authcallback route‑ban, miután az Erste API‑ból lehúztad az accountokat és beállítod a balance‑ot, küldj be minden accountról egy summary‑t: „User {id} Erste account {iban}/{name}, típus: {accountType}, balance: {balance} {currency}”.[2]
  ContainerTag: ["user:{id}", "accounts", "erste"], meta: accountid, iban, currency, lastupdated, így később az AI‑asszisztens átlátja a számlastruktúrát.[1][2]

 Login / user session  
  Az apilogin után, ahol belépteted a usert és visszaadod az ID‑t, a frontenden állíts be egy per‑user chat klienst, ami minden AI‑hívásnál elküldi az x-sm-user-id headerben a user ID‑t a backend felé.[2]
  A backend LLM‑kliense (OpenAI kompatibilis) pedig már a Supermemory Router URL‑re mutasson, fix x-supermemory-api-key‑jel és a kapott user headerrel.[1]

 Analitikai endpointok után  
  A kdbanalyticsbp alatt lévő /revenue, /success-rate, /hourly-volume, /failure-analysis hívások outputját időnként (pl. admin cron) fogd össze 3–4 mondatos riportokba, és töltsd fel Supermemory‑ba ["analytics", "global"] vagy per‑user tagekkel.[2]
  Így épül egy „másodlagos memória” a nyers KDB adatok fölött, amit az AI‑asszisztens könnyebben tud narratív formában felhasználni.[1][2]

 7. Biztonság, tenant‑izoláció, upsert

A dokumentáció alapján a Supermemory tud customId‑alapú upsertet és ID szerinti PATCH‑et, így ugyanazt a logikai entitást (pl. account:{user_id}:{account_id}) verziózhatod, miközben a régi memóriák is a gráfban maradnak.[1]
Ezt használhatod account‑ és user‑profil frissítésekre: a legfrissebb változat lesz isLatest, mégis visszakereshető az evolúció.[1]

Nagyon fontos, hogy minden user‑hez tartozó dokumentumot/memóriát kötelezően tagelj user:{id} containerTaggel, és a kereséseknél mindig szűrj erre, így nem keverednek a tenantok.[1][2]
Metaadatban (metadata) tovább szűkíthetsz (pl. {"role": "end_user"} vs. {"role": "admin"}), ha később admin‑nézetet vagy multi‑tenant SaaS‑t építesz a platformra.[1]

 8. Extra „legfejlettebb” feature‑ötletek

 AI pénzügyi coach  
  Infinite Chat + KDB + Supermemory insight memóriákra építve csinálhatsz egy coachot, aki figyelmeztet szokatlan költésekre, javasol megtakarítási célokat, és emlékszik, mit beszéltetek egy hónapja.[2][1]

 Fraud/anomália előszűrés AI‑val  
  A gyakran failed vagy gyanús mintázatokat (failure‑analysis KDB‑ből) memóriaként jelölheted „risk_pattern” metával, és egy háttér‑LLM‑et futtathatsz, ami scoringot vagy manuális review javaslatot ad.[2][1]

 Multimodális pénzügyi inbox  
  Számla‑fotók, e‑mailek HTML‑je, PDF‑szerződések mind mennek a File Upload API‑ba, a user pedig egy AI‑asszisztenssel kérdez: „Mutasd az összes 2025‑ös telekom számlámat, és írd le a havi átlagot.”[1]
  A Supermemory OCR + chunking + kereső + Memory Router kombinációja elvégzi a heavy liftinget, te csak az üzleti logikát és a UI‑t adod hozzá.[2][1]

Ha szeretnéd, a következő lépésben tudok konkrét Python kódrészleteket írni a te Flask appodhoz: egy supermemory_client.py modult, konkrét memories.add hívásokkal a PaymentProcessor és az authcallback köré, plusz egy teljes /api/chat endpointot Memory Routerrel.[1][2]

class SupermemoryClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api_key = config.SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY
        self.base_url = "https://api.supermemory.ai/v1"
        self.enabled = True

    def _get_headers(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        return {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        }

    def add_memory(
        self,
        content: str,
        container_tags: Optional[list] = None,
        metadata: Optional[dict] = None,
        custom_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Optional[dict]:
        if not self.enabled:
            return None
        try:
            url = f"{self.base_url}/memories"
            payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"content": content}
            if container_tags:
                payload["containerTags"] = container_tags
            if metadata:
                payload["metadata"] = metadata
            if custom_id:
                payload["customId"] = custom_id
            response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=self._get_headers(), timeout=10)
            if response.status_code in (200, 201):
                return response.json()
            logger.error(f"Supermemory add_memory failed: {response.status_code} - {response.text}")
            return None
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Supermemory add_memory error: {e}")
            return None

    def search_memories(
        self,
        query: str,
        container_tags: Optional[list] = None,
        limit: int = 10,
    ) -> list:
        if not self.enabled:
            return []
        try:
            url = f"{self.base_url}/memories/search"
            payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"query": query, "limit": limit}
            if container_tags:
                payload["containerTags"] = container_tags
            response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=self._get_headers(), timeout=10)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                body = response.json()
                return body.get("memories", [])
            logger.error(f"Supermemory search failed: {response.status_code} - {response.text}")
            return []
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Supermemory search error: {e}")
            return []

    def upload_file(
        self,
        file_path: str,
        container_tags: Optional[list] = None,
        metadata: Optional[dict] = None,
    ) -> Optional[dict]:
        if not self.enabled:
            return None
        try:
            url = f"{self.base_url}/memories/upload"
            with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
                files = {"file": f}
                data: Dict[str, str] = {}
                if container_tags:
                    data["containerTags"] = json.dumps(container_tags)
                if metadata:
                    data["metadata"] = json.dumps(metadata)
                headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"}
                response = requests.post(url, files=files, data=data, headers=headers, timeout=60)
                if response.status_code in (200, 201):
                    return response.json()
                logger.error(f"Supermemory upload failed: {response.status_code} - {response.text}")
                return None
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Supermemory upload error: {e}")
            return None


class ErsteAPIClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.config = Config()
        self.base_url = self.config.erste_api_url
        self.web_api_key = self.config.ERSTE_WEB_API_KEY
        self.client_id = self.config.ERSTE_CLIENT_ID
        self.client_secret = self.config.ERSTE_CLIENT_SECRET
        self.redirect_uri = self.config.ERSTE_REDIRECT_URI

    def _get_headers(self, access_token: Optional[str] = None, additional_headers: Optional[dict] = None) -> Dict[str, str]:
        headers: Dict[str, str] = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "web-api-key": self.web_api_key,
            "X-Request-ID": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        }
        if access_token:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {access_token}"
        if additional_headers:
            headers.update(additional_headers)
        return headers

    def create_consent(self) -> dict:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/consents"
        payload = {
            "access": {
                "accounts": [],
                "balances": [],
                "transactions": [],
            },
            "recurringIndicator": True,
            "validUntil": (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=90)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            "frequencyPerDay": 10,
            "combinedServiceIndicator": False,
        }
        headers = self._get_headers()
        try:
            response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            logger.info(f"Consent created successfully: {data.get('consentId')}")
            return data
        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
            logger.error(f"Error creating consent: {e}")

        try:
            if not signature:
                return False
            expected_signature = hmac.new(self.api_secret.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
            return hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, signature)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Webhook signature verification failed: {e}")
            return False

class KdbClient:
    _instance = None
    _connection: Optional[qconnection.QConnection] = None
    _last_ping: Optional[float] = None
    _ping_interval: int = 30

    def __new__(cls):
        if cls._instance is None:
            cls._instance = super(KdbClient, cls).__new__(cls)
        return cls._instance

    def __init__(self):
        if not hasattr(self, "initialized"):
            self.host = os.environ["KDB_HOST"]
            self.port = int(os.environ["KDB_PORT"])
            self.username = os.environ.get("KDB_USERNAME", "")
            self.password = os.environ.get("KDB_PASSWORD", "")
            self.max_retries = 3
            self.retry_delay = 1
            self.timeout = 30000
            self.initialized = True
            logger.info(f"KdbClient initialized for {self.host}:{self.port}")

    def connect(self) -> qconnection.QConnection:
        if self._connection is not None:
            if self._is_connection_alive():
                return self._connection
            self._close_connection()
        last_error: Optional[Exception] = None
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries):
            try:
                logger.info(f"Connecting to kdb+ at {self.host}:{self.port} (attempt {attempt + 1}/{self.max_retries})")
                conn = qconnection.QConnection(
                    host=self.host,
                    port=self.port,
                    username=self.username if self.username else None,
                    password=self.password if self.password else None,
                    timeout=self.timeout,
                )
                conn.open()
                version = conn.sync("string .z.K")
                logger.info(f"Connected to kdb+ version {version}")
                self._connection = conn
                self._last_ping = time.time()
                return conn
            except Exception as e:
                last_error = e
                logger.error(f"Connection attempt {attempt + 1} failed: {e}")
                if attempt < self.max_retries - 1:
                    time.sleep(self.retry_delay * (attempt + 1))
        raise ConnectionError(f"Failed to connect to kdb+ after {self.max_retries} attempts: {last_error}")

    def _is_connection_alive(self) -> bool:
        if self._connection is None:
            return False
        if self._last_ping and (time.time() - self._last_ping) < self._ping_interval:
            return True
        try:
            result = self._connection.sync("1+1")
            self._last_ping = time.time()
            return int(result) == 2
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Connection ping failed: {e}")
            return False

    def _close_connection(self) -> None:
        if self._connection:
            try:
                self._connection.close()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error closing connection: {e}")
            self._connection = None
            self._last_ping = None

    @contextmanager
    def get_connection(self):
        conn = self.connect()
        try:
            yield conn
        finally:
            pass

    def execute(self, query: str, *args) -> Any:
        last_error: Optional[Exception] = None
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries):
            try:
                with self.get_connection() as conn:
                    if args:
                        result = conn.sync(query, *self._convert_args(args))
                    else:
                        result = conn.sync(query)
                    return self._convert_result(result)
            except QException as e:
                logger.error(f"Query error (attempt {attempt + 1}): {e}")
                raise ValueError(f"KDB+ query error: {e}")
            except Exception as e:
                last_error = e
                logger.error(f"Execution error (attempt {attempt + 1}): {e}")
                if attempt < self.max_retries - 1:
                    self._close_connection()
                    time.sleep(self.retry_delay)
        raise RuntimeError(f"KDB+ execution failed after {self.max_retries} attempts: {last_error}")

    def _convert_args(self, args: tuple) -> tuple:
        converted = []
        for arg in args:
            if isinstance(arg, datetime):
                converted.append(arg)
            elif isinstance(arg, Decimal):
                converted.append(float(arg))
            elif isinstance(arg, dict):
                converted.append(arg)
            else:
                converted.append(arg)
        return tuple(converted)

    def _convert_result(self, result: Any) -> Any:
        if result is None:
            return None
        if hasattr(result, "dtype"):
            import pandas as pd

            return pd.DataFrame(result)
        return result

    def upsert_payment(self, payment_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
        data = {
            "payment_id": str(payment_data["payment_id"]),
            "user_id": int(payment_data["user_id"]),
            "amount": float(payment_data["amount"]),
            "currency": str(payment_data["currency"]),
            "payment_method": str(payment_data["payment_method"]),
            "status": str(payment_data["status"]),
            "recipient_name": str(payment_data.get("recipient_name", "")),

    def insert_transaction(self, transaction_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:

            "transaction_id": str(transaction_data["transaction_id"]),

            "payment_method": str(transaction_data["payment_method"]),

            "processing_time_ms": int(transaction_data.get("processing_time_ms", 0)),
        }
        query = ".db.insertTransaction"
        return self.execute(query, data)

    def get_revenue_by_method(self, start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime) -> Any:
        query = ".db.getRevenueByMethod"
        return self.execute(query, start_date, end_date)

    def get_success_rate(self, start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime) -> Any:
        query = ".db.getSuccessRate"
        return self.execute(query, start_date, end_date)

    def get_hourly_volume(self, target_date: datetime) -> Any:
        query = ".db.getHourlyVolume"
        return self.execute(query, target_date.date())

    def get_latency_stats(self, start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime) -> Any:
        query = ".db.getLatencyStats"
        return self.execute(query, start_date, end_date)

    def get_user_payments(self, user_id: int, limit: int = 50) -> Any:
        query = ".db.getUserPayments"
        return self.execute(query, user_id, limit)

    def get_failure_analysis(self, start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime) -> Any:
        query = ".db.getFailureAnalysis"
        return self.execute(query, start_date, end_date)

    def get_recent_transactions(self, minutes: int = 5) -> Any:
        query = ".db.getRecentTransactions"
        return self.execute(query, minutes)

    def health_check(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            with self.get_connection() as conn:
                conn.sync(".db.payments,.db.transactions,.db.accounts")
                memory = conn.sync(".Q.w[]")
                return {
                    "status": "healthy",
                    "connected": True,
                    "memory": memory,
                    "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "status": "unhealthy",
                "connected": False,
                "error": str(e),
                "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
            }

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._close_connection()
        logger.info("KDB+ client closed")


class KdbSyncService:
    def __init__(self):
        self.kdb = KdbClient()
        self.enabled = True
        logger.info("KDB Sync Service initialized")

    def sync_payment(self, payment: Payment, event_type: str = "created") -> bool:
        if not self.enabled:
            return False
        start_time = time.time()
        try:
            payment_data: Dict[str, Any] = {
                "payment_id": str(payment.payment_id),
                "user_id": payment.user_id,
                "amount": payment.amount,
                "currency": payment.currency,
                "payment_method": payment.payment_method,
                "status": payment.status,
                "recipient_name": payment.recipient_name or "",
                "recipient_iban": payment.recipient_iban or "",
                "description": payment.description or "",
                "erste_payment_id": payment.erste_payment_id or "",
                "transaction_id": payment.transaction_id or "",
                "created_at": payment.created_at,
                "executed_at": payment.executed_at,
            }
            self.kdb.upsert_payment(payment_data)
            processing_time = int((time.time() - start_time) * 1000)
            transaction_data: Dict[str, Any] = {
                "transaction_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "payment_id": str(payment.payment_id),
                "user_id": payment.user_id,
                "event_type": event_type,
                "status": payment.status,
                "amount": payment.amount,
                "currency": payment.currency,
                "payment_method": payment.payment_method,
                "metadata": f"{event_type}:{payment.status}",
                "processing_time_ms": processing_time,
            }
            self.kdb.insert_transaction(transaction_data)
            logger.info(f"Synced payment {payment.payment_id} to kdb+ (event: {event_type}, {processing_time}ms)")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to sync payment {payment.payment_id} to kdb+: {e}")
            return False

    def backfill_payments(self, start_date: Optional[datetime] = None, limit: int = 1000) -> dict:
        logger.info(f"Starting payment backfill (limit: {limit})")
        query = Payment.query.order_by(Payment.created_at.desc())
        if start_date:
            query = query.filter(Payment.created_at >= start_date)
        payments = query.limit(limit).all()
        stats = {"success": 0, "failed": 0, "total": len(payments)}
        for payment in payments:
            if self.sync_payment(payment, event_type="batch_sync"):
                stats["success"] += 1
            else:
                stats["failed"] += 1
        logger.info(f"Backfill complete: {stats['success']}/{stats['total']} succeeded")
        return stats

    def health_check(self) -> dict:
        kdb_health = self.kdb.health_check()
        return {
            "sync_service": {
                "enabled": self.enabled,
                "kdb_connected": kdb_health.get("connected", False),
            },
            "kdb": kdb_health,
            "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
        }

            return self.process_coinbase_payment(user_id, payment_data)
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported payment method: {payment_method}")

    def process_erste_payment(self, user_id: int, payment_data: dict) -> dict:
        payment: Optional[Payment] = None
        try:
            if (
                "amount" not in payment_data
                or "recipient_name" not in payment_data
                or "recipient_iban" not in payment_data
                or "debtor_iban" not in payment_data
            ):
                raise ValueError("Missing required payment data fields")
            user = User.query.get(user_id)
            if not user or not user.access_token:
                raise ValueError("User not authenticated with Erste Bank")
            self.erste_client.refresh_token(user)
            payment = Payment(

                amount=Decimal(str(payment_data["amount"])),
                currency=payment_data.get("currency", "HUF"),
                payment_method="erste",
                recipient_name=payment_data["recipient_name"],
                recipient_iban=payment_data["recipient_iban"],

    def check_payment_status(self, payment_id: str) -> dict:
        try:
            payment = Payment.query.filter_by(payment_id=payment_id).first()
            if not payment:
                return {"success": False, "error": "Payment not found"}
            if payment.payment_method == "erste" and payment.erste_payment_id:
                user = User.query.get(payment.user_id)
                if user and user.access_token:
                    self.erste_client.refresh_token(user)
                    try:
                        result = self.erste_client.get_payment_status(user.access_token, payment.erste_payment_id)
                        api_status = result.get("transactionStatus", "").lower()
                        if api_status == "accc":
                            payment.status = "completed"
                            payment.executed_at = datetime.utcnow()
                        elif api_status == "rjct":
                            payment.status = "failed"
                        elif api_status in ("accp", "acsc"):
                            payment.status = "processing"
                        db.session.commit()
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.error(f"Error checking Erste payment status: {e}")
            elif payment.payment_method == "coinbase" and payment.transaction_id:
                charge = self.coinbase_client.get_charge(payment.transaction_id)
                if charge:
                    timeline = charge.get("timeline", [])
                    status = None
                    if timeline:
                        status = timeline[-1].get("status")
                    if status == "COMPLETED":
                        payment.status = "completed"
                        payment.executed_at = datetime.utcnow()
                    elif status in ("EXPIRED", "CANCELED", "FAILED"):
                        payment.status = "failed"
                    db.session.commit()
            elif payment.payment_method in ("apple_pay", "google_pay") and payment.transaction_id:
                pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.retrieve(payment.transaction_id)
                if pi.status == "succeeded":
                    payment.status = "completed"
                    payment.executed_at = datetime.utcnow()
                elif pi.status == "payment_failed":
                    payment.status = "failed"
                db.session.commit()
            return {
                "success": True,
                "payment_id": payment.payment_id,
                "status": payment.status,
                "amount": str(payment.amount),
                "currency": payment.currency,
                "created_at": payment.created_at.isoformat(),
                "executed_at": payment.executed_at.isoformat() if payment.executed_at else None,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error checking payment status: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

def init_database_with_retry(max_attempts: int = 10, base_delay: int = 2) -> bool:
    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            logger.info(f"Database initialization attempt {attempt}/{max_attempts}")
            with db.engine.connect() as conn:
                conn.execute(db.text("SELECT 1"))
            inspector = inspect(db.engine)
            existing_tables = inspector.get_table_names()
            if existing_tables:
                logger.info(f"Database tables already exist: {', '.join(existing_tables)}")
            else:
                logger.info("Creating database tables...")
                db.create_all()
                logger.info("Database tables created successfully")
            logger.info("Database initialized successfully")
            return True
        except OperationalError as e:
            message = str(e).lower()
            if "endpoint has been disabled" in message or "connection" in message or "could not connect" in message:
                delay = base_delay * (2 ** (attempt - 1))
                if attempt < max_attempts:
                    logger.warning(
                        f"Database connection failed (attempt {attempt}/{max_attempts}): {e}. "
                        f"Retrying in {delay} seconds..."
                    )
                    time.sleep(delay)
                    continue
                logger.error(f"Database initialization failed after {max_attempts} attempts: {e}")
                return False
            logger.error(f"Database initialization error: {e}")
            raise
        except IntegrityError as e:
            logger.info(f"Database tables already exist (IntegrityError caught): {e}")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Unexpected database initialization error: {e}")
            raise
    return False

    if uploaded_file.filename == "":

    if not filename:
        return jsonify({"success": False, "error": "Érvénytelen fájlnév"}), 400
    unique_name = f"{current_user.id}_{int(time.time())}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{filename}"
    path = os.path.join(app.config["UPLOAD_FOLDER"], unique_name)
    try:
        uploaded_file.save(path)
        metadata = {
            "user_id": str(current_user.id),
            "original_filename": filename,
            "stored_filename": unique_name,
            "uploaded_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
        }
        container_tags = [f"user:{current_user.id}", "files", "upload"]
        result = supermemory_client.upload_file(path, container_tags=container_tags, metadata=metadata)
        if not result:
            return jsonify({"success": False, "error": "Fájl feldolgozási hiba a Supermemory-ben"}), 500

@app.route("/webhook/coinbase", methods=["POST"])
def coinbase_webhook():
    payload = request.data
    signature = request.headers.get("X-CC-Webhook-Signature")
    coinbase_client = CoinbaseCommerceAPI()
    if not coinbase_client.verify_webhook_signature(payload, signature):
        return "Invalid signature", 401
    try:
        event_body = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return "Invalid payload", 400
    event = coinbase_client.parse_webhook_event(event_body)
    if event:
        charge_id = event.get("charge_id")
        if charge_id:
            payment = Payment.query.filter_by(transaction_id=charge_id).first()
            if payment:
                status = event.get("status")
                if status == "COMPLETED":
                    payment.status = "completed"
                    payment.executed_at = datetime.utcnow()
                elif status in ("FAILED", "EXPIRED", "CANCELED"):
                    payment.status = "failed"
                db.session.commit()
                sync_service.sync_payment(payment, "updated")
    return "OK", 200


@app.route("/webhook/stripe", methods=["POST"])
def stripe_webhook():
    payload = request.data
    sig_header = request.headers.get("Stripe-Signature")
    try:
        event = stripe.Webhook.construct_event(
            payload,
            sig_header,
            os.environ["STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET"],
        )
    except ValueError:
        return "Invalid payload", 400
    except stripe.error.SignatureVerificationError:
        return "Invalid signature", 400
    event_type = event.get("type")
    if event_type == "payment_intent.succeeded":
        pi = event["data"]["object"]
        payment = Payment.query.filter_by(transaction_id=pi["id"]).first()
        if payment:
            payment.status = "completed"
            payment.executed_at = datetime.utcnow()
            db.session.commit()
            sync_service.sync_payment(payment, "updated")
    elif event_type == "payment_intent.payment_failed":
        pi = event["data"]["object"]
        payment = Payment.query.filter_by(transaction_id=pi["id"]).first()
        if payment:
            payment.status = "failed"
            db.session.commit()
            sync_service.sync_payment(payment, "updated")
    return "OK", 200
